Hi Sarah — I'm setting up next week's CSE455 staff meeting. Professor Alvarez's open slots (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) are fairly tight, mostly 30-minute windows:

- Mon 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Tue 11:00–11:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30 or 13:00–13:30

Which of these works best for you and the rest of the TA staff? If you need a full hour, let me know and I'll see what I can rearrange. Thanks!

From Sarah’s calendar, she’s available for Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, or Wed 13:00-13:30. Of those, Wed 13:00-13:30 is probably the cleanest on her end. The Monday options and Tue 11:00-11:30 conflict for her.
Wed 13:00-13:30 works on Professor Alvarez's end too — booked it. Thanks for coordinating, Sarah!
Confirmed. I’ve added the CSE455 staff meeting for Wednesday 13:00-13:30 on Sarah’s calendar. Thanks for coordinating.
All set — Wednesday 13:00-13:30 CSE455 staff meeting is confirmed on both calendars. Thanks, Sarah!
Everything is in place on Sarah’s side as well. Wednesday 13:00-13:30 for the CSE455 staff meeting is confirmed on her calendar. Thanks!
